name: Women's Super League
notes: 2026/27 is the first WSL season with 14 clubs, expanded from 12: Birmingham City (WSL2 champions), Crystal Palace (runners-up) and Charlton Athletic (play-off winners) were promoted; no club was relegated in 2025/26.
Title-sponsored by Barclays since 2019/20; Sky Sports shows the league from 2025/26 under a five-year UK broadcast deal.
Run by WSL Football, a company split from the FA.
